scientific_integrity: Corrected result claims only ordinary homotopy splitting; earlier integral homology and complete rational group characters explicitly credited. Finite acyclic matching and integer degree argument support the homotopy conclusion.
scientific_limitations: Fixed five-crown complex only; no equivariant homotopy or integral higher group representation. Full Björner-Welker 1999 text priority comparison remains inaccessible. Previously published characters are not a new result.
title: Ordinary homotopy splitting of the five-crown matching complex
